About the Program

The Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2026–27 is a Social Initiative of Group Legrand India, launched in 2018 with aim to provide access to higher education for meritorious girl students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds. Since 2022 the scholarship support has been extended to differently abled students & LGBTQ+ students. Through financial assistance, the program aims to reduce barriers in education continuity among girl students, differently abled students & LGBTQ+ students, encourage diversity and inclusion, and empower deserving students to successfully complete their higher education.

*Special category: Differently-abled girl students , students with parent affected in Covid , LGBTQ+ students , Students with Single Parent / Orphans , with physical disabilities, intellectual disabilities, neurodivergent individuals and girl students with differently abled parents.

About Legrand

Legrand is a global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructure. Based in Limoges, Legrand operates in 90 countries with a market presence in over 180 countries. Legrand offers a wide range of products, including:

  • Energy distribution
  • Wiring devices
  • Home automation
  • Structured cabling
  • UPS
  • Lighting management solutions
  • Cable management
  • Industrial application products

Group Legrand India, headquarted in Mumbai, has several brands under its umbrella who are leaders in their respective product domain, namely IndoAsian, Numeric, Valrack, Adlec and NetRack. With a diverse workforce of 5000+ employees across India, Group Legrand India has 7 state of the art manufacturing facilities, 3 R&D centres and a wide distribution network with over 870 distribution partners and 19000+ retailers.

Eligibility Criteria

General Category
Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2026-27
  • Open for girl students across India only.
  • Applicant pursuing the first year of a graduation degree in India.
  • Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the year 2025–26.
  • Applicants must have secured a minimum of 80% and above marks in Class 10 and 12 examinations.
  • The annual family income of the applicant from all sources must be less than INR 5,00,000.
Special Category
Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2026-27
  • Open to differently-abled girl students , students with parent affected in Covid , LGBTQ+ students , Students with Single Parent / Orphans , with physical disabilities, intellectual disabilities, neurodivergent individuals and girl students with differently abled parents individuals across India.
  • Applicant pursuing the first year of a graduation degree in India.
  • Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the year 2025–26.
  • Applicants must have secured 70% marks in Class 10 and 12 examinations. Exceptions may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  • The annual family income of the applicant from all sources must be less than INR 5,00,000.

Scholar Connect Program

Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program

As a component of the Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program, we organize a bi-annual Scholar Connect program. This initiative is designed to provide a platform for students to share their experiences, network, and interact with senior leadership and subject matter experts. Additionally, we acknowledge the achievements of the mentees who successfully completed the Legrand Mentorship Program.

Legrand Mentorship Program

The Legrand Mentorship Program, a Social Initiative of Group Legrand India, under the Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program, is dedicated to empowering aspiring women to pursue higher education and thrive as future leaders in STEM fields. Launched in 2021, the program is aligned with its mission to provide comprehensive support to beneficiaries of the Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program, which includes meritorious and differently-abled girl students and transgender students. Through this initiative, mentees receive personalized guidance to navigate their academic and professional journeys.

Be it Engineering, Architecture, Finance, or Science courses, the mentorship sessions are tailored to equip mentees with the skills, knowledge, and confidence needed to excel in their chosen field.

About the Legrand Mentorship Program

The Legrand Mentorship Program provides a structured pathway for academically promising individuals pursuing diverse courses, ranging from B.Tech/BE/B.Arch. to disciplines like Science or Finance (BSc/BCom/BBA, etc.). Through a series of virtual sessions spanning four months, with one session each month, mentees are provided with opportunities to learn, grow, and connect with industry experts.

Key Features of the Legrand Mentorship Program:
  • Tailored Guidance:With a team of 25-30 mentors from Group Legrand India's Senior Leaders & Subject Matter Experts shaping today's girls as tomorrow's Women Leaders by providing personalized mentoring support tailored to their unique needs and aspirations.
  • Comprehensive Curriculum: The curriculum covers a wide range of topics essential for personal and professional development.
    • From career advancement strategies and building a strong resume to interviewing and leadership skills, mentees are equipped with the tools and knowledge necessary to thrive. Through personalized guidance, they gain the confidence to enhance their personal brand, make informed decisions, and develop a strategic mindset. This holistic approach ensures that mentees are not only prepared to excel in their careers but also empowered to navigate challenges and lead with integrity and purpose.
  • Peer Learning: Through connection with like-minded individuals, mentors encourage mentees to engage in meaningful discussions, share insights, and exchange their experiences.

Impact Since Inception

The Legrand Mentorship Program allows mentors to proactively and passionately contribute to the personal and professional growth of mentees, all while staying aligned with the core values of the organization. Through this program, scholars receive mentoring support from Legrand employees, helping them with career counseling and tailored learning solutions.

Till date 150 Legrand mentees have successfully completed their mentoring journeys and received certificates of completion. Through meaningful interactions with their mentors, each mentee has gained valuable insights, confidence, and guidance that have positively shaped their personal and professional growth. These experiences continue to nurture and empower them as future women leaders, inspiring the next generation while making their families and communities proud.

What Our Scholars Say About Us

AWAEY GURUMAYUM

B.Tech. Civil Engineering (3rd year) Imphal West, Manipur, Legrand 2022 scholar

"Access to education is important for everyone, especially for transgender people since it brings acceptance and respect from society. Education makes us brave because we are able to differentiate between right and wrong and understand our purpose in life. I sincerely thank Legrand for the Legrand Empowering scholarship"

LINGAPRIYA BASAVRAJ

B.E. Computer Science (2nd year) Bidar, Karnataka, Legrand 2022 scholar

"So many girl students in our country have to quit education after Class 10 or 12. I believe that women are not meant to be just limited to household activities. No matter if you are differently abled, every girl should dream high, and initiatives like the Legrand Empowering Scholarship are empowering us to do the same!"

SRINIJA YERRAM

B.Tech Computer Science (2nd year) Adilabad, Telangana, Legrand 2021 scholar

"I feel honoured to be a part of the Legrand Empowering Program, which played a major role in my educational journey. Receiving the scholarship motivated me to study with utmost sincerity. Education makes women independent, strong, and confident and I congratulate Legrand for their endeavours towards the same."

GARIMA DUBEY

B. Tech. Civil Engineering (Final year) Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, Legrand 2019 scholar

"It is said that to achieve our true potential and goals, we have to walk on rough roads. I believe that a mentor is someone who acts like a road sign in that journey! The mentorship sessions under the Legrand Mentorship Program have broadened my perspective. It seems like there's no looking back for me now."

Frequently Asked Questions

  • 1. What is the maximum scholarship amount?

    Scholarship Award:

    • Generic category: All meritorious and deserving girl students.
        Scholarship award amount- 80% of the course fee up to the limit of 80,000/- per annum until the completion of the course.
    • Special Category: Differently-abled girl students , students with parent affected in Covid , LGBTQ+ students , Students with Single Parent / Orphans , with physical disabilities, intellectual disabilities, neurodivergent individuals and girl students with differently abled parents.
        Scholarship award amount- 80% of the course fee up to the limit of 1,00,000/- per annum until the completion of the course.

    Each year the eligible scholarship amount will be disbursed to the student’s given Indian account number after submitting the required documents (relevant fee receipts/college bonafide certificate/previous year mark sheet and bank proofs) through Legrand’s implementation partner, Scholarlify (As per the payment cycle communicated).

  • 2. Who can apply?

    Meritorious girl students who have completed their Class 12 in 2026 and secured admission in the first year of eligible undergraduate courses can apply for this scholarship. The scholarship is open to girl students under the general category as well as special category applicants, including differently-abled (PwD) girl students, LGBTQ+ students, students with a single parent or orphan students, girl students with differently-abled parents, and individuals with physical disabilities, mental disabilities, or neurodivergent conditions. Refer to the eligibility criteria section for detailed information.

  • 3. What is the duration of the scholarship support?

    The scholarship support is provided till the course completion. For example, if a student is has received this scholarship to pursue B.Arch degree, the student shall be supported for all the 5 years of the degree. Similarly, if a student pursuing B.Tech has been selected to receive this scholarship then they may be supported for 4 years and similar for a student with a b.com degree of 3 years. However, the scholarship continuity on each year is based on the student's performance.

  • 4. Are students who passed their Class 12 in 2025 eligible for this scholarship?

      No. This scholarship is available only to students who have passed Class 12 in the academic year 2025–26 and meet the eligibility criteria for their respective category.

    • General Category (Girl Students): Applicants must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12 examinations.
    • Special Category (Differently-abled girl students , students with parent affected in Covid , LGBTQ+ students , Students with Single Parent / Orphans , with physical disabilities, intellectual disabilities, neurodivergent individuals and girl students with differently abled parents.): Applicants must have secured a minimum of 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12 examinations. Exceptions may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  • 5. Do I have to re-apply for the scholarship again in the second year and the following years?

    No, you do not need to re-apply for the scholarship program every year. However, to continue receiving the scholarship until the completion of your graduation, you must submit your current year's documents on the scholarship portal each year for verification and scholarship renewal. The required documents are:

    • Current Annual Fee structure
    • Current Annual Fee Receipt / Fee Bonafide
    • Previous year Marksheet
    • Bank passbook
    • Declaration letter
  • 6. Has the scholarship amount for the General Category been increased?

    Yes, the scholarship benefit for General Category applicants has been increased. Eligible students will now receive 80% of their annual course fee, up to INR 80,000 per year, until completion of their degree program, updated from the previous limit of 60% up to INR 60,000.
    Note:This revised scholarship amount will be applicable from the academic year 2026–2027 onwards and will be reflected for all eligible students, including both the existing batches and the new batches.

Important Update: Effective from the academic year 2026–2027, Scholarlify has been appointed as the implementation partner for this scholarship program, replacing Buddy4Study.
